title: Mixed Number Calculator
description: Add or subtract two mixed numbers with improper-fraction and common-denominator steps shown.
howto: Press Calculate to see every step and the simplified result.

faqs.a: Mixed like 2 1/3, plain fractions like 3/4, or whole numbers like 5 — with an optional leading minus.

faqs.q: How is the common denominator found?
faqs.a: Via the least common multiple of the two denominators, using their GCD: LCM(a,b) = a×b / GCD(a,b).
Yes — the result is reduced by its GCD and shown both as an improper fraction and a mixed number.
